title: [CQ-R13c1] Protected launcher runtime marker
definitionOfDone: Under the PROTECTED profile, the selected agent runtime's env carries MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 beside MOE_DAEMON_PATH and MOE_PROXY_PATH. Shown by TerminalAgentLauncherTest.
The legacy path and a Refused selection never add MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED. Shown by tests.
The verification command exits 0 with its output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
